verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a search bar and a built-in query feature (`{{query ...}}`, `/query`) for asking questions of the knowledge base, and community reports describe it as an offline-first, local-data app. The evidence never details full-text search behavior or tag, property or path filters, and a user reports indexing and responsiveness slowing badly on large graphs, which undercuts "instantly." Missing for 10: documented full-text search, explicit tag/property/path filter syntax, first-party confirmation of offline search, and evidence of fast search on large graphs.
